title: Allergists and Immunologists
description: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent allergic diseases and disease processes affecting the immune system.

tasks.text: Diagnose or treat allergic or immunologic conditions.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI suggests differentials; clinician examines and owns diagnosis

tasks.text: Educate patients about diagnoses, prognoses, or treatments.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Results delivery needs empathy and clinical judgment

dwas.name: Explain medical procedures or test results to patients or family members.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Order or perform diagnostic tests such as skin pricks and intradermal, patch, or delayed hypersensitivity tests.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical ordering requires licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Order medical diagnostic or clinical tests.

tasks.text: Prescribe medication such as antihistamines, antibiotics, and nasal, oral, topical, or inhaled glucocorticosteroids.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Prescribing medications is licensed high-stakes judgment

tasks.text: Interpret diagnostic test results to make appropriate differential diagnoses.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.

tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

tasks.text: Develop individualized treatment plans for patients, considering patient preferences, clinical data, or the risks and benefits of therapies.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Medical plans need exam, liability, and clinical judgment

tasks.text: Provide therapies, such as allergen immunotherapy or immunoglobin therapy, to treat immune conditions.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Chronic disease management needs clinical judgment
visual inspection — Patient physical assessment is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Examine patients to assess general physical condition.

tasks.text: Assess the risks and benefits of therapies for allergic and immunologic disorders.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Treatment guidance aided; clinical accountability human

dwas.name: Evaluate treatment options to guide medical decisions.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Coordinate the care of patients with other health care professionals or support staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Perform allergen provocation tests such as nasal, conjunctival, bronchial, oral, food, or medication challenges.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Administering screening tests needs live patient interaction

dwas.name: Administer screening tests to determine abilities or treatment needs.
Conduct diagnostic tests to determine patient health.

tasks.text: Engage in self-directed learning and continuing education activities.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI summarizes medical updates; human retains judgment

tasks.text: Provide allergy or immunology consultation or education to physicians or other health care providers.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical advice needs licensed accountability and context

dwas.name: Advise medical personnel regarding healthcare issues.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Conduct laboratory or clinical research on allergy or immunology topics.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Literature review aided; wet-lab and clinical research human

dwas.name: Conduct research to increase knowledge about medical issues.

tasks.text: Present research findings at national meetings or in peer-reviewed journals.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Medical research presentation needs human delivery
